footer.summary: Luxury yacht charter from Botafoc Marina, Ibiza. Twenty years on the water, one phone call.

home.tagline: One platform. Endless experiences at sea.

intro.title: A day on the water. A memory for life.
intro.body: From the moment you step aboard at Botafoc Marina to the moment you watch the sun dissolve into the Mediterranean, every detail is handled. The captain knows where the other boats aren't. The chef knows what the sea wants you to eat. You just bring the people.
